title: 2026 UK PRTR 2024 XML publication and reporting-boundary QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: Download industrial emissions and waste transfer (UK PRTR) data

sources.publisher: Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: UK Pollutant Release and Transfer Register (PRTR) data sets

facts.source_fact: Defra published the 2024 UK PRTR reporting-year dataset as an XML download on 30 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach reporting year and publication date to every extracted row.

facts.source_fact: The PRTR download publication provides annual datasets for industrial emissions and waste transfers.
facts.expected_handling: Keep each reporting year versioned separately.

facts.source_fact: The UK PRTR is moving to a new system and XML downloads are provided during the transition.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat system migration as a change in emissions values unless documented.

facts.source_fact: PRTR data includes facility identity and, where applicable, parent-company information.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve facility identity before joining records.

facts.source_fact: PRTR information includes facility geographical location and river-basin context.
facts.expected_handling: Keep geographic fields separate from parcel geometry.

facts.source_fact: PRTR records include the relevant industrial activity.
facts.expected_handling: Apply activity classification before comparisons.

facts.source_fact: PRTR records identify the pollutant or waste being reported.
facts.expected_handling: Do not aggregate unlike pollutants or waste types without explicit mapping.

facts.source_fact: PRTR records identify releases to air, water or land.
facts.expected_handling: Keep environmental media separately traceable.

facts.source_fact: PRTR includes off-site transfers of waste and destination information where applicable.
facts.expected_handling: Distinguish transferred waste from on-site pollutant releases.

facts.source_fact: PRTR can include off-site transfers of pollutants in wastewater.
facts.expected_handling: Keep wastewater transfers distinct from direct water releases.

facts.source_fact: Defra aims to publish PRTR information approximately one year after the calendar year under report.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the reporting-year lag to freshness assessments.

facts.source_fact: Operators submit annual emission and waste information to the appropriate regulator.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve operator-report provenance.

facts.source_fact: Regulators compile and check operator-reported PRTR information before publication.
facts.expected_handling: Record regulator QA as a separate provenance layer.

facts.source_fact: PRTR quality checks include cross-referencing operator reports with permit information.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer permit compliance solely from a PRTR row.

facts.source_fact: Inspection and monitoring information can be used to validate reported PRTR data.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve validation-source provenance.

facts.source_fact: Quality assurance includes scrutiny for omissions, errors and incomplete information.
facts.expected_handling: Represent missing values as missing rather than zero.

facts.source_fact: Industrial PRTR releases are generally point-source data tied to facilities or sites.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix point-source PRTR data with diffuse-emission inventories.

facts.source_fact: Industrial activities and pollutants are subject to specified PRTR reporting thresholds.
facts.expected_handling: A missing pollutant row is not automatically evidence of zero emissions.

facts.source_fact: The UK PRTR implements public availability requirements under UK legislation and the PRTR protocol.
facts.expected_handling: Keep public-register purpose distinct from emissions-measurement method.

facts.source_fact: Absence of a facility or pollutant from the public dataset can result from scope or threshold rules and is not automatic proof of non-compliance.
facts.expected_handling: Require permit-level evidence before negative compliance inference.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable dataset, entity, geography or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference period, release/update date and provisional/current/final status.
Carry source URL, publisher and calculation, reporting or quality-method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert aggregate, facility, industry or scheme-level evidence into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
